name: Dongchimi
description: Radish fermented in clear salted brine with no chilli — the broth is the point.

tcm.note: A cold clear brine ferment; radish is cooling.

ayurveda.note: Shita; drunk as much as eaten.

histamine.note: Still a ferment, chilli or no chilli — and the brine is drunk, not drained.
